name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2490: A17s heading carries a separator inside its own title, TV-D, so the A-list parser failed to match and the task was absent from the board with nothing saying so. The generator reports orphaned rows but a row that never parsed was never a row - so coverage() now counts every A-header in the file against the rows derived and names any that produced none. Seen red with the original regex restored. Also six moving tasks filed as PENDING because the classifier read the header word READY, which says whether a task may be started and not whether it has been.
